ITEM 1 | Rectangular wedge on upper left of plate, about 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, golden-orange top with melted pale cheese patches and browned spots, layered edges with pale cream-colored interior visible at cut edge, slightly glossy surface with moist sheen, holds shape | 110
ITEM 2 | Cluster of bite-sized pieces at lower center-left, roughly 8 cm by 7 cm, tan-brown with darker browned crust and flecks, irregular chunky shapes, some pale cut surfaces, slightly glossy and coated, sits on plate with small green herb sprigs tucked among them | 120
ITEM 3 | Single elongated piece at center-right of the chicken cluster, about 7 cm long and 3 cm thick, pale tan-cream skin with light golden browning and sheen, smooth rounded shape with slightly bumpy surface, appears to be a drumstick-like piece with a thinner bone-end | 85
ITEM 4 | Thin green herb sprigs, several pieces about 4 cm long, bright to dark green with feathery leaves, dry-looking, placed between the meat pieces and the carrots | 4
ITEM 5 | Roasted carrot pieces at lower right, about 6 of them, each 5 to 7 cm long and 1.5 to 2.5 cm thick, bright orange with darker caramelized edges and char spots, glossy with light oily sheen, firm and holding shape, one piece showing deep blackened charring | 75
ITEM 6 | Glossy orange-brown glaze or pan sauce coating the carrots and pooling lightly on the plate beneath them, thin layer, sticky sheen, flowing slightly around carrot pieces | 15
